summary: Solvent and styrene free based, two-component polyester anchoring adhesive.

attributes: Can be used at low temperatures

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Complies to NCC 2019 reference to AS 5216:2018 - Design of post-installed and cast-in fastenings in concrete
Injection system for use in masonry according to ETAG 029, ETA-12/0227, Declaration of Performance 020403010010000001 5034408, certified by notified product certification body 0679, certificate of constancy of performance 0679-DPD-0777, and provided with the CE marking
Bonded injection type anchor for non cracked concrete according to ETAG 001 annex 1 and 5, ETA-13/0720, Declaration of Performance 020403010010000001 5034408, certified by notified product certification body 1020, certificate of constancy of performance 1020-CPD-090-029816, and provided with the CE marking.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text:
12 months from date of production
All Sika AnchorFix®-1 cartridges have the expiry date printed on the label.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Stored properly in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.

items.label: Density
items.text: ~1.63 kg/l (component A+B mixed)

items.label: Compressive strength
items.text: ~60 N/mm2 (7 days, +20 °C) | (ASTM D 695)

items.label: Tensile strength in flexure
items.text: ~28 N/mm2 (7 days, +20 °C) | (ASTM D 790)

items.label: Tensile strength
items.text: ~12 N/mm2 (7 days, +20 °C) | (ASTM D 638)

items.label: Temperature resistance
items.text:
Long term | +50 °C
Short term (1–2 hours) | +80 °C

items.label: Glass transition temperature
items.text: +60 °C | (DIN EN ISO 6721-1)

items.label: Design considerations
items.text: For details about adhesive anchoring design refer to the separate documentation provided: “Technical Documentation Sika AnchorFix®-1” Ref: 870 43 01

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Component A : component B = 10 : 1 by volume

items.label: Layer thickness
items.text: 3 mm max.

items.label: Sag flow
items.text: Non-sag, even overhead

items.label: Material temperature
items.text: Sika AnchorFix®-1 must be at a temperature of between +5 °C and +40 °C for application.

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: -10 °C min. / +40 °C max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least 3 °C above dew point.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: -10 °C min. / +40 °C max.

items.label: Curing time
items.text:
Temperature | Open time - Tgel | Curing time - Tcur
+30 °C | 4 minutes | 35 minutes
+25 °C – +30 °C | 4 minutes | 40 minutes
+20 °C – +25 °C | 5 minutes | 50 minutes
+10 °C – +20 °C | 6 minutes | 85 minutes
+5 °C – +10 °C | 10 minutes | 145 minutes
+5 °C | 18 minutes | 145 minutes
–10 °C 1 2 | 30 minutes | 24 hours
1 Minimum cartridge temperature: +5 °C
2 This application is not covered by the scope of the product ETA or any other approval.

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text:
Mortar and concrete must be at the required strength. No need to be 28 days old.
Substrate strength (concrete, masonry, natural stone) must be verified.
Pull-out tests must be carried out if the substrate strength is unknown.
The anchor hole must always be clean, dry, free from oil and grease etc.
Loose particles must be removed from the holes.
Threaded rods and rebars have to be cleaned thoroughly from any oil, grease or any other substances and particles such as dirt etc.

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Getting the cartridge ready: 300 ml / 550 ml
1. Unscrew the cap
2. Cut the film
3. Screw on the static mixer
4. Place the cartridge into the gun and start application
When the work is interrupted the static mixer can remain on the cartridge after the gun pressure has been relieved. If the resin has hardened in the nozzle when work is resumed, a new nozzle must be attached.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean tools and application equipment with Sika® Colma Cleaner immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.
